correctness.rationale: The prior exact pair criterion (Girish–Somasundaram 2024, Lemma 2) gives six complete state types. Direct local slide formula gives every edge, a six-row table of degrees and square incidence, and an explicit connectivity path. Handshake gives 24n edges and degree polynomial, parity of pair distance gives bipartiteness, and 76n local square incidences yield 19n cycles. Local admissibility has no wraparound anomalies for n>=8. Separate direct propagation and symbolic state programs reproduce all assertions across independent finite ranges; they are checks, not a substitute for the uniform argument.

originality.rationale: Novelty is deliberately restricted to the physical adjacent-slide reconfiguration graph, its complete six-type transition table and connected/bipartite/four-cycle classification. The 2024 lemma exactly covers feasibility and 11n vertices, which are credited, while archival Xu–Kang (2011) addressed power-domination minima in generalized Petersen graphs. The 2026 reconfiguration article defines TS while studying TAR and TJ without prism-specific conclusions. Literature and research-record comparisons did not show these additional properties; terminology risks remain.
residual_risks: An equivalent previously published cyclic two-token configuration graph and square table may exist under alternative terms rather than power domination.
The 2011 generalized-Petersen power-domination article was accessible only by abstract and secondary discussion; it was not used to declare its full text non-covering.
The original 2002 foundational article was only partially available in full text; it is background, not used to exclude plausible coverage.
No independent priority review has been performed.

value.rationale: Physically sliding existing optimal measurement units without ever losing complete monitoring is a natural constrained reconfiguration model. The exact six-type mobility law determines local degrees for every globally optimal placement; connectedness permits arbitrary relocation; bipartiteness restricts possible move sequences even on odd prisms; 19n four-cycles quantify alternative two-slide paths between valid placements. This is meaningful structure not implied by the already-known optimal cardinality or pair classification alone.
